column3: “the LORD my God” differs from the Hebrew “the LORD your God”; NASB supplies “in office.”
“My father” renders “my ancestor”; “few in number” renders “with men of fewness,” and “populous” renders “numerous.”
“has brought” and “has given” render Hebrew past forms.
NASB moves “you and the Levite and the alien” to the front.
“the sacred portion” renders “the holy thing”; “my house” renders “the house.”
“while mourning” renders “in my mourning”; “while I was unclean” renders “in uncleanness.”
“the ground” renders “the land”; NASB moves “as You swore to our fathers” to the end.
“His people, a treasured possession” renders “a people of treasured possession”; “promised” renders “spoke.”
